info.name: OpenTripMap Geographic coordinates of populated place Objects list API

params.name: lang
params.description: Language code (2 characters, ISO639-1). The following values are available: en (english), ru (russian)

params.name: lon_min
params.description: Minimum longitude

params.name: lon_max
params.description: Maximum longitude

params.name: lat_min
params.description: Minimum latitude

params.name: lat_max
params.description: Maximum latitude

params.name: src_geom
params.description:
The source of the object geometry.
Objects from all sources are returned by default.

params.name: src_attr
params.description:
The source of the object attributes.
It is allowed to point multiple sources separated by commas.
Objects from all sources are returned by default.

params.name: kinds
params.description:
Object category. Several comma-separated categories may be stated with OR logic. [see List of categories](https://dev.opentripmap.org/catalog). 
Objects from interesting_places category are returned by default

params.name: name
params.description: The text string on which to search at the begining of the object name (mimimum 3 characters). All objects are returned by default.

params.name: rate
params.description:
Minimum rating of the object popularity, 1 - minimum, 3- maximum, h - object is referred to the cultural heritage.
Objects from all ratings are returned by default.

params.name: format
params.description: The output format (GeoJSON  is set by default). Specify “count” to get the number of obtained objects

params.name: limit
params.description: MMaximum number of returned objects. 500 is set by default.

items.docs:
Method returns all objects (or number of objects) in the given bounding box optionally filtered by parameters. Only basic information is include in response: xid, name, kinds, osm, wikidata and geometry of each object.
Depending on the chosen format, the response is either a simple array of objects (with a smaller volume) or an object in GeoJSON format.

items.docs:
Method returns objects closest to the selected point optionally filtered by parameters. Only basic information is include in response: xid, name, kinds, osm, wikidata and geometry of each object.
Depending on the chosen format, the response is either a simple array of objects (with a smaller volume) or an object in GeoJSON format.

params.name: name
params.description: The query term on which to search. The minimum number of characters for name is 3

params.name: radius
params.description: Maximum distance from selected point in meters

params.name: lon

params.name: kinds
params.description:
Object category. Several comma-separated categories may be stated with OR logic. [see List of categories](https://dev.opentripmap.com/ru/catalog.tree.json). 
Objects from all categories are returned by default.

params.name: rate
params.description:
Minimum rating of the object popularity, 1 - minimum, 3- maximum, h - object is referred to the cultural heritage.

params.name: format
params.description: The output format (GeoJSON  is set by default). Specify “count” to get the number of obtained objects

params.name: props
params.description: Specify “base” to search only in the objects titles (set by default), specify “address” to search in the objects addresses too

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of returned objects. 10 is set by default.

items.docs: Method returns suggestions for search term closest to the selected point optionally filtered by parameters. Only basic information is include in response: xid, name, kinds, osm, wikidata of each object. Depending on the chosen format, the response is either a simple array of objects (with a smaller volume) or an object in GeoJSON format.
